scope: Direct source-context review of entire A module; join all inventoried sites to reviewed owner context, preserving original AST outcomes/operators. T temporal/state/order; P price/priority; N declaration/other control. Not independent execution.

contexts.meaning: Record fields distinguish main index/time, exact event and Decimal; formation route and exact Blue stop fields are declared presentation-only, not acceptance inputs.
Validate exact direction; preserve Reaction input order; stable Blue sort by integer reaction ordinal, source time, string kind. Hold source chronology references.
Precompute First and Break main times and exact confirmation in Reaction order (virtual confirmation override allowed). Separate native naive ordering flags.
Directional strict stop/improvement and source mapping/window delegated to shared policy/chronology, no new timing rule.
Lower search [lower_bound(start),lower_bound(end)) or length. Nonempty with index uses direction strict first crossing, null is authoritative; map exact row to main; no coarse fallback.
Without indexed nonempty path scan lower slice in order; first strict crossing returns main owner/exact time/price. Any lower rows suppress coarse fallback.

Only empty lower slice: scan main opens from max(0,lower_bound(start)) up to lower_bound(end) clamped to start or end length. No containing main before start. Return actual candle index/time and directional value.
Reject reversed range. Inclusive end implemented as end+1us. Indexed nonempty returns earliest directional min/max and owning main timestamp.
Nonempty unindexed lower range seeds first and updates only strict improvement; ties first. Return lower price but mapped main source.

Empty lower range: start containing main via upper_bound−1 clamped at zero; end containing main bounded by last and at least start. Scan inclusive main range, strict update keeps first tie; no fallback guard for invalid source indexing.

Validate one-based Reaction ordinal even for Reset. Scale uses aligned Break index and exact A confirmation for formation and stop scan. Other kind uses source index, Reset formation query, stop scan at main end. Read mapped candle before return.
Scan Reset main lower interval for first strict brokenLevel crossing; absent crossing returns main open even if lower evidence exists.

Enumerate all sorted lines, skip invalid only after ordinal assigned. Valid states include internal lines. Stop from formation-specific start unbounded; absent stop fields null, hit exact lower timestamp and main open distinct.

Double-stop tracks last valid Blue. Invalid without prior skips; else scan previous sourceExtreme from invalid line sourceTime to invalid main end exclusive; require hit main equal invalid source index.
Select first Reaction confirmation>=trigger and First>=invalid formation. Null match or source skips preserving previous.

Emit double-stop with both effective stop main times equal invalid main, continuation from previous Blue, exact trigger, frozen source, optional stop event fields null. Successful emit consumes previous; failure does not.
Require previous exact/main stop and prior exact stop <= expiry if supplied. Evaluate inherited stop first.

Inherited result searches strict crossing from current formation to expiry exclusive; no crossing ends selected route, no fallback. Effective previous stop is inherited level source time; effective current is trigger main.

If previous exact stop < current formation, freeze range extreme through current formation main open−1us inclusive; reversed range propagates. Search current formation to min(main end,expiry) exclusive; hit yields prior actual stop main and trigger main effective current.
If no formation crossing require current actual/exact stop, stop <= expiry. Scan continuation from current exact stop to expiry exclusive; no hit null. Both effective stop main times actual.

Else require current stop and expiry bound inclusive. Stable sort two stops by event then level (lower level R, negated level B). Assert exact times and event extremes; continuation from first exact extreme/main owner.
Equal stop exact times use second stop index/event directly, no further strict price check; can be exactly expiry. Original previous/current effective main stop times preserved.
Different stop times search from second exact stop through expiry exclusive; absent hit null, else return continuation+trigger+original two effective stop main times.
A confirmation always delegates with use_intrabar_start=false, not generic intrabar default.

Fast first Reaction match only for nonnegative start, ordered confirmation times/native naive trigger and optional ordered native naive First gate. Take max of start and lower bounds; both gates inclusive; return original ordinal/object if in bounds.
Fallback traverses from supplied position (negative not normalized), first confirmation>=trigger and First>=optional gate, returns one-based ordinal; no re-sort.

Require previous formation strictly earlier. Chained if both stop fields present, exact stop strictly before current formation and neither internal. Unchained Scale cannot inherit; other kind can. Window starts previous stop MAIN time if chained, formation otherwise.
Ordered native First times permit upper-bound start; otherwise zero. Skip First<=start. Require Break strictly before current formation; ordered Breaks permit termination, otherwise continue.
First eligible Reaction yields extreme from start through complete Break main (Break+timeframe−1us) chained, Break open inclusive otherwise. Return level/index/time and Break main time; none null.
Source frozen from trigger main open to exact A confirmation inclusive; if reversed null. Reorder extreme tuple to source index/time/price; no post-confirmation data where lower rows exist.
Walk adjacent valid states; skip current formation<=cycle Break OR previous<=cycle Break unless matching retained bridge ordinal. Clear reuse only for skipped bridge pair; advance one.
Expiry next valid state's formation or null. Failed pair trigger advances one.
Match first Reaction with exact confirmation>=trigger and First>=max(effective stops). No match terminates entire ordinary loop; no source advances one.
Emit ordinary record using effective main stop times, actual stop levels, source/trigger/Reaction provenance. Exact stop field copied only if effective and actual main stops equal.

Cycle boundary matched Break. Scan A first strict stop from confirmation unbounded. Reuse current Blue only when stop exists, next-next valid state exists and its formation>=stop exact. Else clear and skip all formations<=cycle Break.
Remove double-stop candidates sharing nonnull Reaction ordinal with ordinary candidates.
For each remaining special choose latest ordinary source strictly earlier (first max tie). Reject if prior first strict stop before special First and not before special Blue1 source.
Build retained special two-ordinal sets/event. Remove ordinary only if strictly later trigger AND overlapping ordinal set. Equal triggers not consumed. Keep relative orders.
Build valid states, ordinary then special, filter, stable sort combined ordinary+special by source time and exact trigger. Zone construction native fields, no normalization.
A prior stop test starts actual source candle index+1; no next main false. First strict crossing to exclusive end; null false; require hit>=optional not_before, no rescan for recross.
Standalone wrapper builds and detects; history holds separate confirmations, resets, crossings, extremes, matches, inherited stops, triggers, sources, zones.

Fresh history with prior reference/dirty then base constructor virtual confirmation. Compare zipped First/Break/confirmation triples in order, record length equality and common prefix; changed time min Break across old/new suffixes. Not whole Reaction equality.
Settled iff dirty exists and event strictly before dirty. Reaction window also requires changed time absent or end<=changed time.
Confirmation key Break index/string confirmation-side level; current cache first. Previous reuse if Break main open settled and key present; else native A confirmation.
Reset formation key source index/string broken level; reuse old if main open settled and key exists, else compute; store fresh (not current-first).

Cross key string level/start/end. Current cached hit/null returns. Compute lower presence. Prior reusable when start<dirty and bounded end<=dirty OR old hit<dirty with unchanged lower availability; preserve pair.

Dirty lower position min(right,lower_bound(dirty)). If old lower and unchanged prefix lower exists, no lower suffix implies cached null/true; otherwise scan from dirty. If no old/current lower also scan from dirty. All other cases scan original start. Store result with current has_lower.
Extreme key start/end; old reuse when end settled, otherwise current hit then native. Store selected result; no rounded price.

Match key trigger/not_before. Current cache first, then prior ordinal<=common prefix; previous null reusable only with identical triple sequence. Otherwise rescan at common prefix when prior key exists, else zero. Return current object by ordinal.
Blue cache key formation index/time, stop index/main/exact time, string stop level/extreme, kind, internal truthiness. Omits ordinal and drawing price.
Inherited stop key pair Blue keys; reuse previous nullable result iff current formation settled Reaction window; store.

Trigger key pair+expiry. Reuse only nonnull expiry, current formation settled Reaction window, all nonnull expiry/previous formation/previous stop/current stop settled, old key present. Else native; store nullable.
Source key trigger index/exact confirmation. Old result reusable only both endpoint times settled and key exists. Else native source freeze; store.
Zone key ordered supplied fields with Decimal replaced by sign/digits/exponent tuple; reuse old same object if key yields nonnull, else construct. Store; no numerical normalization.
Live wrapper seed fresh detector with prior/dirty null, detect then retain. Result shallow list.

Require same timeframe and dirty index within [0,min(old,new counts)]. Dirty time min available timestamps at index across old/new; default new last+timeframe or null. Construct fresh detector, detect successfully, release old history, then replace wrapper state. No commit on failure.
